title: The candidate gate fired and the region converged on the reference
why: The required fixed-candidate case: `resolved` outranks `candidate-changed`, and only the comparison against the *reference* tells 'it was fixed' apart from 'it changed into something else'. It carries an **adjacent regression** two pixels outside the mask edge on purpose — a resolved acceptance contributes no mask to the scoring union, and the wrong reading keeps suppressing that neighbour.
